mvp.name: MVP Challenge

unlock.name: MVP Challenge
unlock.text: Requires completing Main Quest 142: Clear Main Stage 4-12

mvp.rules:
1. The MVP Challenge mode yields Card rewards, including powerful Legendary MVP Cards.

2. As your Base Level increases, more MVP instances become available. Each MVP drops unique Rare, Epic, and Legendary quality cards.

3. Clear MVP stage for one-time reward , unlock higher difficulty, and face stronger MVPs.

4. Each MVP dungeon can be swept to receive sweep rewards for the highest difficulty stage cleared . You can sweep 3 times  per day.  Sweep count is independent for each MVP dungeon .

unlock.name: Angeling
unlock.text: Requires completing Main Quest 142: Clear Main Stage 4-12

worldBoss.name: Baphomet Challenge

unlock.name: Baphomet Challenge
unlock.text: Requires completing Main Quest 63: Clear Main Stage 2-6

worldBoss.rules:
1. Deal a certain percentage of Baphomet's Max HP for the first time to earn a one-time reward. Defeating Baphomet advances the stage, where you face a stronger version, but you cannot defeat the final-stage Baphomet.

2. A certain percentage of points is awarded based on damage dealt to Baphomet. Compete with other players based on the points you have earned.

3. Rewards are distributed based on your ranking at the daily scheduled time. Even more generous rewards are given out at the weekly settlement.

endlessTower.name: Endless Tower

unlock.name: Endless Tower
unlock.text: Unlocks after clearing Main Stage 6. Pyramid-12 and on the 4th day after character creation

endlessTower.rules:
1. Gameplay Introduction: Challenge Endless Tower floor by floor. First clear of each floor grants First Clear Reward. After a victory, you automatically proceed to the next floor until you fail or reach the top.

2. Challenge Attempts: 5 attempts available daily. Starting a challenge consumes 1 attempt. Consecutive challenges do not consume additional attempts. Attempts are not refunded on failure.

3. Threat Level: The more floors cleared that day, the higher the Threat Level, and monsters in the tower are strengthened accordingly. Threat Level resets daily at 0:00.

4. Daily Sweep: After clearing Floor 1, Sweep becomes available. Sweep rewards are based on the highest floor cleared. 1 free Sweep available daily.

5. Ranking: Ranked by the highest floor cleared.

categories.rules:

categories.rules: Clear stages for Base EXP & Job EXP. Get 3 daily tickets. Combat lasts 40 sec, defeat all targets to win. Killing required Normal Mobs every 10 sec grants a large DMG bonus.

teamPve.name: Dungeon

unlock.name: Dungeon
unlock.text: Requires completing Main Quest 124: Clear Main Stage 4-6

teamPve.rules:
1. Mode Introduction: Dungeons are a 3-player team challenge mode. You must form a full party of 3 to enter. You can unlock higher-level stages and face stronger opponents as you progress through the Main Story.

2. Team Formation & Recruitment: You can freely create a room and recruit teammates by sending Recruitment Cards, inviting friends, or sharing an Invite Code. You can also join another player's room through these methods to clear stages.

3. Auto-Match: The system will automatically match you with suitable teammates based on your Combat Power. Note that repeatedly declining to join a matched party will trigger a temporary Matchmaking Cooldown.

4. Rewards: Your daily Clear Attempts and Helper Attempts are reset automatically by the system each day. Upon a successful challenge, the system will prioritize using your Clear Attempts to distribute rewards. When these are exhausted, you can use Helper Attempts to earn Helper Coins, which can be exchanged for rewards in the Dungeon Shop. Failing a challenge will not consume any attempts.

5. Rankings: The system features a Leaderboard ranking players by team achievement points and completion time. It is a core display of your strength and glory.

guildBoss.name: Guild Hunt

unlock.name: Guild Hunt
unlock.text: Requires completing Main Quest 151: Clear Main Stage 5-3

guildBoss.rules:
1. Gameplay: Guild Hunt can be challenged 3 times per day. The Boss has 4 phases. Defeating the current phase brings a stronger Boss. The final phase Boss cannot be defeated. Each challenge starts from Phase 1.

2. Points: Points are calculated based on DMG dealt to the Boss in each phase.

3. Challenge Rewards & Loot: Each challenge grants Challenge Rewards and, based on the phase reached, brings Loot Chests back to the Guild for members to open.

4. Sweep: After having a challenge record, you can Sweep. Each Sweep consumes 1 Challenge Attempt, grants Challenge Rewards, and brings back Loot Chests to the Guild based on the best result of the current period.

5. Transfer Restriction: Players who transfer Guilds that day will not bring back loot from challenges, nor can they receive loot brought back by other members.

6. Cumulative Points Rewards: Claim Cumulative Points Rewards when daily cumulative points reach the requirement. Resets daily at 0:00.

7. Leaderboard: The Personal Leaderboard ranks by each player's highest points this period and is for display only; the Guild Leaderboard ranks by Guild Points, which is the sum of all members' highest points this period.

8. Tier Rewards: Every Monday at 0:00, Guild Tier is settled based on Guild Points and ranking, and the corresponding Privilege Skills are granted to all Guild members. Privilege Skills expire when their duration ends.

arena.name: Rune Arena

unlock.name: Rune Arena
unlock.text: Requires completing Main Quest 197: Quick Idle 1 time(s)

arena.rules:
1. In Rune Arena, both sides engage in 1v1 automatic combat. All players on the server can join Rune Arena to compete for ranking.

2. Combat has a time limit. When time runs out, the side with the higher remaining HP percentage wins.

3. During combat, DMG reduction attributes are uniformly increased based on the average Base Level of both sides, and additional DMG Boost status is granted to both sides as combat time increases. Control effect durations in combat are also significantly reduced.

4. Challenging opponents consumes Rune Arena Challenge Tickets. Daily login restores up to 5 tickets for free.

5. Defeating opponents grants points, raising Tier and Rank. Losing deducts points, which may cause Tier demotion.

6. Tier Rewards are one-time rewards and reset each season. Ranking Rewards are divided into Season Rewards and Daily Rewards, and are sent via mail upon settlement.

7. Arena Coins obtained from Rune Arena rewards can be exchanged for precious items in the Arena Shop. The Arena Shop refreshes on the 1st of each month at 00:00.

8. A new season begins every Monday at 00:00. The system resets based on the previous season's Tier and retains a portion of season points.

gvg.name: Guild War
gvg.rules:
1. Guild War is a cross-server guild versus guild mode. Members compete for strongholds through 1v1 automatic combat, earning Battle Points for the guild to claim victory, tier, and ranking.

2. Guild War opens every other week. Once the guild has 10 members, the Guild Leader or Vice Leader can register during the registration phase. Participating members are locked when registration succeeds; members who join afterward cannot take part in this match's battles. If a registered member leaves the guild, their assigned stronghold remains.

3. For each match, registration opens at 00:00 on Day 1, closes at 00:00 on Day 2 and enters matching, then stronghold battles start at 12:00 and settle at 22:00. Exact schedule follows in-game display.

4. After successful registration, the system auto-assigns strongholds by member Combat Power—higher power means a higher-tier stronghold. The Guild Leader can adjust defenders during the registration phase only; no changes after matching begins.

5. Each member may attack 3 times per match and cannot attack the same stronghold twice. Win or lose, you receive attack rewards and Attack Points. Breaking a stronghold also grants Breakthrough Points; different stronghold tiers grant different points.

6. If an attack fails, the defender's remaining HP is kept as a percentage for later attacks. Each stronghold yields Breakthrough Points at most 3 times. After the cap, you can still attack for attack rewards and Attack Points, but no more Breakthrough Points.

7. Defense uses your pre-saved Defense Formation; if none is set, the current formation is used. The Defense Formation can be updated anytime (may apply with a short delay). Growth attributes on the Defense Formation do not sync automatically—update it manually after improving your build.

8. When the match ends, the guild with higher Battle Points wins; if tied, higher total Combat Power wins. Victory increases Guild War Points; defeat may deduct points, affecting guild tier and ranking. Members who attacked at least once this match receive settlement rewards via mail.

9. Guild ranking in the war zone is by Guild War Points; ties compare total Combat Power. Weekly Ranking Rewards are sent after the last match of an open week; Season Ranking Rewards after the last match of the season. To claim either, you must have attacked at least once this season and still be in the guild at reward time. Rewards are sent by mail.

10. Each season lasts 8 weeks. At the start of a new season, the system resets and retains part of Guild War Points based on the previous season's tier. Reach set attack counts to claim Progress Rewards. Cumulative attack counts do not reset with the season.

11. If the number of guilds in the match pool is odd, one guild gets a Bye Round. That guild skips stronghold battles this match and receives Bye Round point adjustment and compensation rewards at settlement instead of regular settlement rewards.
